context: Hina and Sho talk about going to kindergarten.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、幼稚園、行ってる？
lines.en: Sho, do you go to kindergarten?
lines.style: Bright, eager opening with genuine curiosity. Animated but not rushed. Bouncy eight-year-old energy, the kind that makes adults smile. Warm throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、毎日。お友達、たくさん。
lines.en: Yep, every day. I have lots of friends.
lines.style: Soft, quiet pride in the answer. Six-year-old sincerity — not performing, just sharing. Gentle smile audible. Small, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: いいなぁ、ひな、幼稚園、来年。
lines.en: That's so cool — Hina starts kindergarten next year.
lines.style: Wistful but hopeful. Bright eight-year-old anticipation mixed with just a touch of envy. Dreamy, looking forward. Voice lilts slightly upward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: You'll have fun too, for sure.
lines.style: Quiet reassurance from a six-year-old who means it. No hesitation — just small-voiced certainty. Warm, protective somehow. Soft confidence.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: やった、一緒の、感じ、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yes! It'll be like we're together — that makes me so happy.
lines.style: Pure joy bursting through. Eight-year-old delight at the idea. Bright attack on the opening. Tender close. The warmth of having an older friend to look up to.
